1/3.name: Investigator / Martyr
1/3.headline: Build a foundation through trial and error
1/3.body: Your profile combines deep research with hands-on experiment. Line 1 needs a foundation — careful study, knowing the details before moving. Line 3 learns by doing, often through mistakes. A lot of "I tried that, here's what happened" runs through your life. That isn't failure — that's how you learn.

1/4.name: Investigator / Opportunist
1/4.headline: Deep study + sharing through your inner circle
1/4.body: Line 1 builds authority through deep study. Line 4 carries it through close networks — friends, family, the people who know you. Big life moves usually come through someone you already know, not from out of the blue.

2/4.name: Hermit / Opportunist
2/4.headline: Natural talent surfaced by your circle
2/4.body: You have a natural talent that shows up without pushing — others often see it before you do. Line 4 pulls you out of hermit mode through invitations from your close network. Solo time to refuel is essential — protect it.

2/5.name: Hermit / Heretic
2/5.headline: Practical solutions that others project onto you
2/5.body: Natural talent (line 2) plus the role of being called in when there's a practical problem (line 5). People hold high expectations of you — sometimes higher than fair. It can feel heavy, but when you deliver, the impact reaches further than you'd guess.

3/5.name: Martyr / Heretic
3/5.headline: Experiment + practical solutions that shift others
3/5.body: Line 3 learns by trying and falling; line 5 projects solutions. Your life is full of trial and error, and what you discover often becomes the key for others. People project things onto you, fair and unfair — both come with the role.

3/6.name: Martyr / Role Model
3/6.headline: Three phases: experiment, observe, model
3/6.body: This profile has the clearest life arc. Phase 1 (0-30) is hands-on trial and error. Phase 2 (30-50) is "up on the roof" — observing from a distance. Phase 3 (50+) descends as a role model carrying the wisdom of phases 1 and 2.

4/6.name: Opportunist / Role Model
4/6.headline: Influence through close networks, a long arc
4/6.body: You influence the world through your close network — friends, family, inner circle. Line 6 gives you the three phases (see 3/6). The difference from 3/6: you don't have to experiment as much yourself — you learn through the people close to you.

4/1.name: Opportunist / Investigator
4/1.headline: Deep foundation + intimate network — a fixed fate
4/1.body: A fixed-fate profile — you're here for a specific purpose. Line 1 needs a deep foundation; line 4 carries it through the inner circle. Life moves usually come through people who already know you, and you need deep study before passing it on.

5/1.name: Heretic / Investigator
5/1.headline: Solution-bringer with a solid foundation
5/1.body: Others see you as a solution-bringer (line 5), and you do have the deep foundation to back it up (line 1). But watch out: projections from others can be heavy. When you deliver something real, you're honored. When expectations aren't met, you're blamed faster than fair.

5/2.name: Heretic / Hermit
5/2.headline: Universal solver + solo time to refuel
5/2.body: A solution-bringer (line 5) who also needs space (line 2). People lean on you, and you also need to disappear briefly to refuel. Don't feel guilty about solo time — it's what lets you keep delivering.

6/2.name: Role Model / Hermit
6/2.headline: Three phases + natural talent that gets called out
6/2.body: Three-phase profile (see 3/6), with natural talent at line 2. The observation phase (30-50) becomes especially important for you — that's when you refine the natural talent that was there from the start.

6/3.name: Role Model / Martyr
6/3.headline: A role model who's still experimenting
6/3.body: Three-phase profile (see 3/6) with the line 3 still experimenting. Even in the role-model phase (50+), you keep trying things — that's what makes your role-modeling authentic. You're not a role model because you have the answers; you're one because your trial and error is honest.
